background_notes.fact: If z∈[0,∞] and z<∞, then z.toReal is a nonnegative ordinary real and ofReal(z.toReal)=z; this is the unique nonnegative real representative of z.

grounds.reason: dimH E takes values in the extended nonnegative reals.
E004 instantiated at the n,E of H001 gives dimH E<∞.
D is defined as (dimH E).toReal, using the real-value map on this codomain.
ofReal embeds each nonnegative real unchanged into the extended nonnegative reals.

background_notes.justification: The extended nonnegative reals consist of the nonnegative real values together with the top element ∞. A value strictly below ∞ lies in the finite part. On that part the real-value map returns the underlying nonnegative real and ofReal is its inverse. Injectivity of the embedding on nonnegative reals proves uniqueness. Applying this to z=dimH E proves F001 without any new hypothesis.
